name: Academic Certificate Verification
author: Syed Tarikul Islam

sections.description:
Academic Certificate Verification is a comprehensive WordPress plugin that allows you to create and manage a certificate verification system on your website. Users can verify the authenticity of certificates by entering a certificate ID and code, or by visiting a custom verification URL.

All Shortcode:

  • Certificate Verification Form : [acceve_certificate_verification]
  • Certificate Display : When plugin active that time create a page “Verify Certificate” with this [acceve_certificate_display] this shortcode.

Key Features:

  • Easy Verification: Users can verify certificates using a simple form or direct URL
  • Custom URLs: Clean URLs like /verify-certificate/{certificate-id}/{certificate-code}/
  • Admin Management: Full CRUD operations for managing certificates
  • Shortcode Support: Embed verification forms anywhere with [certificate_verification]
  • Bulk Import/Export: Import and export certificates via CSV files
  • Responsive Design: Works perfectly on all devices
  • Customizable: Easily extend with hooks and filters
  • No External Dependencies: Works out of the box

Use Cases

  • Educational institutions verifying student certificates
  • Training centers validating course completion certificates
  • Event organizers checking participation certificates
  • Companies verifying employee training certificates
  • Online course platforms validating completion certificates

Roadmap

  • Different template of certificate
  • Template redesign

Additional Information

For support, visit https://tarikul.top or contact via hello@tarikul.top.

Credits

  • Developer: Syed Tarikul Islam
  • Website: https://tarikul.top/
  • QueueCommerce
  • Special Thanks: WordPress community for inspiration and support
sections.installation:
Method 1: WordPress Admin Dashboard

Go to Plugins → Add New in your WordPress admin
Search for “Certificate Verify”
Click Install Now
Click Activate

Method 2: Manual Upload

Download the plugin ZIP file
Go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin
Choose the ZIP file and click Install Now
Click Activate
